resources.string: Revoke this app’s Google access and return to onboarding? Your local records, pending changes and Drive file will be kept. An internet connection is needed to revoke access.
Delete all local products, receipts, stock movements and pending changes? Unsynced records will be lost. The Drive file will not be deleted. A later sync can restore its records to this device.

Work on one device at a time. Save local changes, sync, then edit the file. Avoid editing in Sheets while an upload is running.\n\nKeep worksheet names and row-1 headers in their original order at A1. Do not insert formulas into data fields. Keep the (Paninda) suffix on all six app worksheets. Other worksheets can hold your own data.

Sync paused: both copies have changed. Keep both copies and compare them before continuing.

To keep this device’s version separately, disconnect and create a new file. To restore the file version, first preserve unsynced records elsewhere, then reset local data and sync. Reset discards unsynced local changes.

Automatic merge and force-overwrite actions are not available.

The saved file failed its data-contract check. Keep a copy, then restore its worksheet names, (Paninda) worksheet names, original row-1 headers and field values. Retry sync after the repair.\n\nAlternatively, disconnect and create a new file from this device’s records.
